status: Confirmed missing security-profile coverage for BE19000AI single 5 GHz band; live repair not applied.
user_setting_confirmed: BE98 client BSSs and main profile entries for its 2.4 GHz and both 5 GHz radios are WPA2/WPA3-Personal (psk2sae).

synchronization.interpretation: Equal version numbers do not establish that the source profile covers every node radio.

log_evidence: cm_applyCfgAction logs show node wl1.2 SSID and BSS enable changes; wl0.2_auth_mode_x changes psk2 to psk2sae, while no corresponding wl1.2_auth_mode_x change appears in the retained log. Initial timestamps are before clock synchronization and cannot establish wall-clock dates.

source_evidence.finding: Uses supplied security string as-is; default generated masks are 3,13,16,96, which include bit 2. This does not prove which path originally wrote the current 1,4,8,16 profile.
Current stock UI branch generates masks 1,14,16,96; 14 includes all three 5 GHz identifiers 2,4,8.
AP group shared implementation falls back to prebuilt amas_apg_shared.o; fallback behavior was not proven from C source.

confidence_limits: Missing band-2 security coverage is directly established from live master profile and live per-node mapping.
Its relationship to the retained WPA2 setting is strongly supported, but a corrective apply and external scan have not yet established causality experimentally.
The retained data does not identify which UI, migration, or manual-write path originally produced this profile.
Node apm profile NVRAM is empty; cfg_client applies generated wl-interface fields, so raw apm equality between master and node is not a valid synchronization check.

proposed_minimal_repair.operation: Add an explicit band-mask 2 security entry inheriting WPA2/WPA3-Personal, AES, and the existing 5 GHz credential; preserve all current entries. Check existing 5 GHz credentials agree before selecting the inherited entry.
proposed_minimal_repair.apply_requirement: Use verified AiMesh/SDN synchronization path and verify node wl1.2 auth_mode_x=psk2sae, akm includes sae, mfp=1, hostapd includes SAE, and external scan PSK+SAE.
proposed_minimal_repair.operational_limit: Existing restart_wireless path can affect wider LAN state; no apply or restart performed in this investigation.
